channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Server Token Grabber
item.description: Allows you to grab the server token in earlier versions to claim your server on the server browser.

item.title: Distant Vistas
item.description: Distant Horizons-style far LOD terrain. Current release 0.7.11. Client and server mod; on multiplaye

item.title: TassHardcoreWinter
item.description: Deeper snow, white out blizzards, restorative spring, realistic room temperature, heat source rework

item.title: Temporal Relics
item.description: Adds randomized affixes to found equipment, introducing mundane, corrupted, and temporally enhanced

item.title: TassModFixesTweaks
item.description: A catch all mod for anything that does not fit my other mods - fixing bugs and tweaking mods

item.title: TassFactions
item.description: Factions - Raids - Sieges - Shops - Bounty

item.title: TassBetterFishing
item.description: Fish are now worth catching

item.title: TassSpawnControls
item.description: Spawn controls and special spawn tree

item.title: Valioso
item.description: Valioso Mod

item.title: Arcticia - Eskimos
item.description: Adds a custom class for Snowball Earth playthroughs.

item.title: Resonator Overhaul
item.description: Per-resonator volume, falloff and looping — saved to the world and audible with Music off.

item.title: GamepadCompanionVS
item.description: Native gamepad support for Vintage Story 1.22+ — 12-slot radial menu, virtual cursor for GUI, etc.

item.title: The Hunter
item.description: Track prey, follow blood, carry carcasses, compost dung, and have smarter wolves.

item.title: Niltrias's Sinister Cookery
item.description: Low-effort AI mod built for personal server only. Should not be used by anyone.

item.title: Niltrias's Sinster Animal Tweaks
item.description: Adds primitive tanning and calming gen 1 animals more. Extensive AI. For personal server.

item.title: Olla
item.description: Bring ancient irrigation technology to Vintage Story! This mod adds ollas (pronounced "oy-yahs")

item.title: DRRP Caveshrooms
item.description: Adds a mushroom that fruits from patches of temporally unstable substrate deep in caves.

item.title: Tweakfactory
item.description: Tweakmod um Klassenspezifische Rezepte einzubinden.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Casuariidae Plus
item.description: A collection of Cassowary, Emu and flightless Australian birds from human history.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Sirenia
item.description: A collection of manatee and dugong from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Machairodontinae
item.description: A collection of saber cats from human history.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Caninae
item.description: A collection of dogs from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Capreolinae
item.description: A collection of New World deer from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Pantherinae
item.description: A collection of big cats from human history.

item.title: Diverse Diets
item.description: Allows base game foods to be used for feeding animals and placed in troughs

item.title: Fields and Plateaus
item.description: Changes world gen to a more natural world that favors fields and plateaus.

item.title: Plains and Valleys
item.description: Changes world gen to a more natural world that favors open plains and valleys.

item.title: Floral Zones: Neozeylandic Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Neozeylandic Region to the game.

item.title: Floral Zones: East Asiatic Region
item.description: Adds plants from the East Asiatic Region to the game.

item.title: W4RD0's Furniture
item.description: A furniture pack adding detailed furniture like tables, chairs, couches, beds, shelves & a lot more.
